name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Israeli ground raid in central Gaza 18 Nov
summary: Israeli tanks crossed the Yellow Line into central Gaza on 18 Nov, the first ground push since the ceasefire
state: On 18 Nov Israeli tanks advanced along Salahudeen road in central Gaza; the military said it was targeting Hamas infrastructure west of the Yellow Line (Reuters via RTÉ). Hospital officials said three Palestinians were killed in the first ground push since the ceasefire began (Al Jazeera). Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the truce took effect; Israel says five of its soldiers were killed. With Iran's strikes on Gulf states, this keeps the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories and neighbouring countries.
rubric_hit: Ground incursion breaching the Gaza ceasefire alongside Iran–Gulf strikes = multi-front escalation, Alert
